exposure: ultrasonography and robotic-assisted sacrocervicopexy with pubocervical fascia reconstruction (u-RALS-PFR)
outcome: anterior/posterior vaginal dissection and mesh tensioning time
cohort: Thirty women with symptomatic vaginal apical prolapse who desired minimally invasive surgery were included.
finding: The u-RALS-PFR technique for symptomatic apical/anterior vaginal prolapse appears feasible and safe, and while it adds some additional surgical time, it may provide better outcomes compared to s-RALS.
